build_evaluation_prompt: build a prompt to evaluate a docstring description across motivation, usage, integration, and functionality aspects
parse_llm_response: parse an LLM response to extract overall score and suggestions for docstring improvement
extract_description: extract the description section from a Python docstring by skipping summary and parameter sections
review_docstring_quality: review the quality of a Python docstring description using the DocstringDescriptionEvaluator class
initialize_criteria: initialize evaluation criteria for docstring aspects including motivation, usage scenarios, integration, and functionality
